scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.check:release: pnpm test:release-contract && pnpm check:release-records && pnpm check:favicon-visual && pnpm check:pwa && pnpm check:published-favicons
scripts.check:published-favicons: if test -z "$PUBLISHED_URL"; then echo "PUBLISHED_URL is required for the post-deploy favicon check." >&2; exit 1; fi; pnpm --filter @workspace/wealthone-expenses run check:published-favicons
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
